title: Bundled Findings
description: Some hostile mobs can now rarely drop a bundle with randomised loot inside!
body:
## About
A datapack that adds randomized bundles rarely dropping from certain mobs! These bundles can include a variety of items from rotten flesh, gunpowder and paper to potions, tipped arrows and even diamonds!

### Works in vanilla minecraft, no mods required!

## Bundle types!
These bundles have four different types:
- generic
- illager (2x drop chance)
- polar
- desert

## Supported mobs
- Bogged
- Evoker
- Husk
- Parched
- Pillager
- Skeleton
- Stray
- Vindicator
- Witch
- Zombie villager
- Zombie

# Installation
## For a new world
1. In the world creation page click "more" then "datapacks"
2. Click "open pack folder"
3. Put this datapack in there
4. Create the world
5. Enjoy!
## For an existing world
1. In the recourcepacks page click "open pack folder"
2. navigate back to the ./minecraft folder
3. Go to saves -> the name of your world -> datapacks
4. Put this datapack in there
5. Restart the world or run /reload in game and you should see `Bundled Findings [version] loaded!`
6. Enjoy!
